$comment: Every source that records a firing row in public.operational_alert_events must declare how that row resolves. Read by tests/every-alert-producer-declares-its-resolve-path.law.test.ts. Kinds: in-function (a migration-defined function resolves it; 'resolvers' names it), twin-event (the external sender posts a resolved twin, payload.resolves = firing event_key), mirror (a copy of financial_alerts / ca_drift_incidents rows, resolved with its original), informational (never paged, recorded for history only), pending (no resolve path yet: an owner and a hard 'until' date; the build fails after that date). Enumerated from production on 2026-11-24 (30 days of operational_alert_events) and from every literal fn_record_operational_alert(s) call in supabase/migrations.
